items.exampleEn: I get up early every day.
This is my second time in Japan.
My son is six years old.
I waited for half an hour.
I have a math class in the first period.

items.sentenceEn: The meeting starts at half past six.

items.audioEn: Sorry, I am late. I will be there soon.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我遲到了，我很快就到。

items.sentenceEn: I will be back in a moment.
We get up early on Monday.

items.stemEn: The train leaves at six. Please don't be ____.
items.stemZh: 火車六點開，請不要遲到。

items.stemEn: I will call you back in a ____.

items.passageEn: School starts at eight. Today Ken gets up late, at half past seven. He runs to the bus stop. The bus comes soon, and he gets to school at eight. He is not late! In the second period, he has a math test.
items.passageZh: 學校八點上課。今天 Ken 很晚才起床，七點半才起來。他跑到公車站，公車很快就來了，他八點到學校，沒有遲到！第二節課他有數學考試。

rubricZh: soon 表示「很快」，常放在句尾（例如 arrive soon），也可放在 will 後面（例如 will soon arrive）
未來的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、is coming）

items.instructionZh: 用 early 造一個句子，說說你很早做的一件事。
referenceEn: I get up early on Monday.
I go to work early every day.
rubricZh: early 常放在動詞片語後面（例如 get up early、go to work early）
時態配合內容（例如習慣用現在簡單式；昨天的事用過去式）
